goal: Compose a read-only Sleep Memory view from a supplied Heart beat and a verified Engram prefix.

target.description: A deterministic, offline projection over a bounded synthetic Engram ledger.
target.source: Shared Heart, Engram and Sleep Memory ingredient contracts.

oven.assumption: A reviewed local Python integration can supply the declared interfaces.
oven.implementation: Invoke the read-only projection on a supplied beat.
oven.verification: Exercise the supplied beat and compare the ledger bytes before and after projection.

acceptance: Record deterministic projection and byte preservation for a synthetic ledger. Require separate Baker acceptance.

anchors.statement: Produce the due derived views from the supplied Heart beat and verified prefix.
anchors.test: Pass beat 6 and a verified synthetic Engram prefix, then check fast and medium views against the source head.

anchors.statement: Preserve the original Engram bytes while producing the view.
anchors.test: Compare the complete ledger bytes before and after projection.
